title: Practice Time-of-Day Rhythm
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:session
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats sum(duration_min) as minutes by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows the times of day you most often pray or meditate, helping you protect a rhythm that works.
value: Anchoring practice to your natural rhythm makes it far more likely to stick.
implementation: Ingest practice sessions into `index=personal`; sum minutes by hour of day.
visualization: Column chart of practice minutes by hour of day.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It shows what times of day you usually take quiet time, so you can protect that part of your routine.
